description: This file defines the MembershipAPI class, a REST API endpoint for managing 'Membership' entities within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It provides methods for CRUD operations including getOne, getAll, create, update, and delete, utilizing various services, models, and validators to handle membership data and enforce validation rules.

classes.name: MembershipAPI
classes.description: API controller class providing CRUD operations for Membership entities in the OrangeHRM admin plugin.

methods.name: getMembershipService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the MembershipService instance used by this API.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Membership by its ID, returning it as a MembershipModel instance.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, requiring a positive integer ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Membership entities, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method, including sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Membership entity based on request data.

methods.name: saveMembership
methods.description: Saves the provided Membership entity, assigning the name from request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new Membership, including required name.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Membership identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a Membership, including unique name validation ignoring current ID.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rules for the 'name' parameter, enforcing string type, max length, and uniqueness.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes Membership entities specified by a list of IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete operation, requiring an array of integer IDs.
